name: lead-leak-check-mcp
description: Find where inbound leads are silently dropped in Zapier, Make and n8n pipelines.
long_description: Turns a description of your lead pipeline (or a run-history CSV) into a ranked list of lead-leak risks, each with a concrete fix. Runs fully offline: no network calls, no data leaves your machine.

tools.name: check_pipeline
tools.description: Check a structured lead-pipeline config and return a ranked leak-risk list.

tools.name: check_pipeline_description
tools.description: Check a plain-English description of a lead pipeline.

tools.name: analyze_run_history
tools.description: Analyze a Zapier/Make/n8n run-history CSV for failed, filtered and missing runs.
